title: Comparing Classes and Templates between Dynamics GP and Dynamics Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Creating customer templates in Business Central
Applying templates to new and existing customers

features.name: Customer templates
features.description: Templates in Business Central allow users to streamline creation of new customers by pre-populating fields like credit limit, salesperson, posting groups, and dimension values based on regional or business criteria.
caveats: Template form requires personalization to display all desired fields

features.name: Form personalization for templates
features.description: Users can personalize the template form to add custom fields like credit limit and salesperson by dragging them onto the template window.

features.name: Template creation from existing customer
features.description: Users can create a template from an existing customer record if they have values they want to use for other customers.

features.name: Posting groups in customer templates
features.description: Customer templates can set default business and customer posting groups to ensure correct sales and accounts receivable accounts are used for customers in a group.

features.name: Dimension defaults in templates
features.description: Templates can set default dimension values such as region to ensure transactions posted to sales accounts are categorized correctly.
